summary.text: Amanda Heath is the Democratic candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Kati McCormick.

paragraphs.text: Heath was a candidate for Augusta City Council, Ward 3, in the nonpartisan November 4, 2025 election, and lost to incumbent Michael Michaud, 477 votes (38.0 percent) to 649 (51.8 percent).
